c-f044fa20250a6662.texto: There is no reason to suppose, as some commentators have done, that these camels were loaded with all that they could carry “of every good thing of Damascus.” It was merely the Oriental desire for display which sent the forty camels. No doubt the royal present was really valuable…

h-36ba12e9a583384f.texto: Continúa hasta la liberación de Joaquín en Babilonia. Sin introducción propia de JFB ni Poole en el repositorio.
